states.offline: You're offline — showing what's saved. Anything you write will be sent once you reconnect.
states.errorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.
states.serverUnreachableBody: Check your connection and try again. Your data is safe.

permission.camera: Camera access is needed to take a photo.
permission.photos: Photo library access is needed to pick photos.
permission.location: Location access is needed to tag a place.

validation.birthDateIncomplete: Enter your full date of birth.

password.common: This password is too common. Pick another one.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your cozy space for two.

verify.title: Verify your email

verify.locked: Too many wrong tries. Locked for {{minutes}} min.
verify.missingEmail: We lost your email address. Sign in or sign up again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. You'll be signed out on other devices.
reset.done: Your password is updated. Sign in with your new one.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

notMe.title: Wasn't you?
notMe.body: We'll sign you out everywhere and ask for your password next time.
notMe.done: You've been signed out everywhere. Reset your password and sign in again.
notMe.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

oauth.failed: Couldn't sign in with Google. Please try again.
oauth.linkBody: An account with this email already exists. Enter its password to link them.

policyUpdate.title: We've updated our policy
policyUpdate.subtitle: Please read and accept the new version to continue.

profile.title: Tell us about you
profile.subtitle: Choose how your person will see you.
profile.avatarLater: You can add a photo later in Settings.
profile.cityUnavailable: City search isn't available right now. You can add it later in Settings.

timezone.body: This device is in a different zone from your profile ({{current}}).
timezone.failed: Couldn't change your time zone. You can change it later in Settings.

create.title: Invite your person
create.subtitle: Send this code to your person. They enter it in Aura to join you.
create.expired: This invite has expired. Create a new one.
create.shareMessage: Join me on Aura! Invite code: {{code}}
create.linkCopied: Invite link copied — paste it wherever you like to send it.
create.cancelled: Invite cancelled. This code won't work anymore.
create.cooldown: You can start a new pairing after {{date}}. Take a little breather.

enter.title: Enter your invite code
enter.subtitle: Type the code your person sent you, like AURA-7K3M. The last 4 characters are enough.
enter.invalid: Codes look like AURA-7K3M — they never contain 0, O, 1 or I.
enter.scanHint: Hold the invite QR code inside the frame.
enter.scannedInvalid: That QR isn't an Aura invite. Try typing the code instead.
enter.cameraDenied: Without camera access we can't scan the QR. Type the code below, or allow the camera in Settings.

link.title: You're invited to Aura
link.body: Open the Aura app and enter this code. Don't have the app yet? Sign up first.

join.title: Invite
join.joinBody: Once you join and {{name}} confirms, your shared space opens.
join.waitingBody: This screen moves on by itself as soon as {{name}} confirms.
join.requestBody: Confirm and the two of you will be connected in your shared space.
join.notFound: No pending request. The invite may have been cancelled or you're already connected.

startDate.title: Since when have you been together?
startDate.subtitle: Both of you enter the day it all started and confirm.
startDate.label: Start date
startDate.future: The date can't be in the future.
startDate.confirmedBody: You both confirmed it. The counter starts from this day.
startDate.waitingPartner: Your suggestion: {{date}}. Waiting for {{name}} to confirm.
startDate.mismatchBody: You each entered a different day — pick one or edit it.

linked.title: You're connected!
